findings.quote: The reaction mixture was allowed to cool then filtered through celite, washing with ethyl acetate. The filtrate was evaporated under reduced pressure to give a brown residue.
findings.message: The filtration does not identify the retained stream or connect it to evaporation. Explicitly retain the filtrate and route evaporation to its receiving vessel; this is a logical vessel identifier, not a claim about apparatus.

An ethyl acetate Add step alone does not capture the stated washing operation. Preserve the wash as an unmapped action because the allowed operations lack a Wash operation and the source does not specify the precise wash target or collection details.

value.reason: The ethyl acetate Add step records the wash reagent but not the physical washing operation. No Wash operation is available; the precise wash target and collection details are unspecified.
